facts.business: India Tourism Development Corporation Limited (ITDC) operates in the travel, tourism, and hospitality sector, managing hotels like The Ashok and providing tourism-related services.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to inability to determine delay in payments to MSME entities and related interest liability under MSMED Act, 2006, as per Note 29 of Note 39 of Standalone Financial Statements.

key_risks: Dampening of travel sentiment post Operation Sindoor in Q1 FY 2025-26
Protracted theatre of war in Eastern Europe
Non-compliance with MSMED Act payment timelines leading to potential stoppage of travel-related services
